style: Soft natural window light, overhead or 45-degree angle, light wood or cream marble surface, cream linen and dusty-pink props, shallow depth of field, calm, clean, minimal, warm editorial food photography. No faces, no people except hands, no text, no letters, no logos, no watermarks.

frames.name: 01-brush
frames.prompt: Close-up of her hands holding a wooden hairbrush with strands of shed dark hair caught in the bristles, soft window light, gentle and calm mood. Absolutely no face, chin or hair of the mother visible; frame from the shoulders down.

frames.name: 02-sofa
frames.prompt: A mother in soft loungewear sits in a cosy armchair holding a warm mug, a sleeping newborn wrapped in a dusty-pink knitted blanket beside her on the nursing pillow, calm and reassuring. Absolutely no face, chin or hair of the mother visible; frame from the shoulders down.

frames.name: 03-calendar
frames.prompt: A small linen-bound desk calendar on a wooden table open to month four with a soft dusty-pink circle drawn on it, a cup of tea and a sprig of flowers beside it, no readable words or numbers.

frames.name: 04-baby-hand
frames.prompt: Close-up of a mother's hand gently holding her newborn's tiny hand on a cream knitted blanket, warm soft light, tender moment. Absolutely no face, chin or hair of the mother visible; frame from the shoulders down.

frames.name: 05-lab-check
frames.prompt: On a wooden table: a blank medical check-up form on a clipboard with a pen, a phone, and a cup of tea; her hand rests on the form, calm morning light, no readable text. Absolutely no face, chin or hair of the mother visible; frame from the shoulders down.

frames.name: 06-ingredients
frames.prompt: Overhead flat lay on a light kitchen surface of small speckled ceramic bowls: golden flaxseeds, black chia seeds, green pumpkin seeds, walnuts, black nigella seeds, sesame seeds, black raisins and dried figs, plus a small bottle of olive oil and a jar of honey, beautifully styled.

frames.name: 07-grind
frames.prompt: Her hands pour only golden flaxseeds and black chia seeds into a small spice grinder on the kitchen counter by the window; beside it small bowls of whole pumpkin seeds, walnuts, sesame, nigella seeds, black raisins and dried figs wait, close-up.

frames.name: 08-mix-jar
frames.prompt: Her hand drizzles golden honey and a little olive oil into a glass bowl where ground flax and chia are mixed with WHOLE pumpkin seeds, walnut pieces, sesame, nigella seeds, black raisins and chopped dried figs on the kitchen counter, a spoon beside it.

frames.name: 09-spoon-yogurt
frames.prompt: Close-up: her hand adds one spoonful of the chunky mix of seeds, walnuts, raisins and figs onto a bowl of yogurt with oats on a breakfast table, morning light.

frames.name: 10-jar-final
frames.prompt: A mother in soft loungewear holds the glass jar of the chunky mix of seeds, walnuts, raisins and figs with a small spoon in it, sitting in a cosy armchair, warm evening lamp light, peaceful. Absolutely no face, chin or hair of the mother visible; frame from the shoulders down.
